shortDescription: Resource module for Ipam Site Ip Address Pools

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. The `id` of the IP address subpool to delete.

options.name: ipV4AddressSpace
options.description: Ipam Site Ip Address Pools's ipV4AddressSpace.

options.name: ipV6AddressSpace
options.description: Ipam Site Ip Address Pools's ipV6AddressSpace.

options.name: name
options.description: The name for this reserve IP pool. Only letters, numbers, '-' (hyphen), '_' (underscore), '.' (period), and '/' (forward slash) are allowed.

options.name: poolType
options.description: Once created, a subpool type cannot be changed. LAN Assigns IP addresses to LAN interfaces of applicable VNFs and underlay LAN automation. Management Assigns IP addresses to management interfaces. A management network is a dedicated network connected to VNFs for VNF management. Service Assigns IP addresses to service interfaces. Service networks are used for communication within VNFs. WAN Assigns IP addresses to NFVIS for UCS-E provisioning. Generic used for all other network types.

options.name: siteId
options.description: The `id` of the site that this subpool belongs to. This must be the `id` of a non-Global site.

options.name: siteName
options.description: The name of the site that this subpool belongs to.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
